usedFor: Nozbe holds your tasks and projects, and Calendly gets a booking link when “Create Scheduling Link” follows “New Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task” in Nozbe, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new task creates a scheduling link, so you can book the time it needs.

watchOut: “Update or New Task” also fires on edits, so the same task can create a second link.
